title: Austrian Greetings, Kaffeehaus Essentials & Everyday Politeness
subtitle: Grüß Gott, Servus, Verlängerter, and navigating Viennese cafés & everyday shops
summary: Start speaking authentic German in Vienna, Salzburg, and beyond from minute one—pairing warm Austrian greetings and Kaffeehaus staples with their Standard German equivalents while progressing from survival words to diplomatic Konjunktiv II.
communicativeCanDo: Greet shopkeepers, servers, and friends naturally using Grüß Gott, Servus, and Auf Wiederschauen alongside Standard German equivalents.
Ask for everyday essentials like das Sackerl and der Bankomat and split compound nouns like Schlag·obers and Kaffee·haus.
Order coffee and pastries politely in a Viennese Kaffeehaus using Ich hätte gern... and ask for the bill.
Recount an evening at a Beisl in the Perfekt tense and formulate ultra-polite Viennese requests with Konjunktiv II.
culturalInsight: UNESCO recognizes Viennese Kaffeehaus culture as intangible cultural heritage: ordering a single Verlängerter arrives on a small silver tray with a glass of cold Alpine tap water, giving you an unspoken license to read, write, or converse for hours without ever being rushed.
